name: Dimensions -A Journey in the Horizon of the Life-
source:
The story follows the experiences of a seraph that a dimensional travel has been lost in an big exoplanet.
will have to choose whether to escape from this world. Or will return to make a new life. but a strange disease called XOS forced him to find a cure before making a decision.

This will be one of the few visual novels that have lighting effects.
